answer: In this PoA design, every identity locks bonded collateral, while correlated equivocation by \(k\) coordinated identities incurs slashing proportional to \(O(k^2)\), rather than separate linear fines. Once a sybil swarm is detected, an exponential multiplier applies to aggregate capital loss, and asymmetric depreciation prevents rapid recovery. Thus, attacks spanning violet, karst, or delta domains become economically irrational even when identities are cheaply created.
